about_p1: Opera is located at the top of the Illume Hotel in the heart of Taipei. Perched on the 15th floor, it commands a one-of-a-kind panoramic view overlooking Taipei Arena and the iconic 101 tower.
about_p2: You will not be provided with just drinks — you will experience true craftsmanship. Every cocktail is a performance, every visit a memory.
bartender_bio: Previously owner-operator at R&D (Asia Top 50 Bar), Yann is a cocktail maestro, obsessed with flavors and always on the lookout for the next delightful beverage.
menu_intro: Every cocktail on our menu is built from the ground up. We craft all our syrups in-house and prepare each infusion ourselves — steeping spirits with fresh fruits, botanicals, flowers and spices to draw out flavors you won't find in any bottle off a shelf. From a watermelon syrup made the morning of service to an oolong-infused whiskey left to rest for days, every ingredient is intentional, every detail considered.
res_note: Table or entire section available for booking. Prices are minimum spend — all drinks and food included.
res_cta_text: Ready to book your table? Reach out to us directly — we'll confirm your reservation within 24 hours.
trusted_intro: Opera has been regularly hosting corporate events, transforming the space to match each client's needs and branding — from intimate gatherings of 20 to full buyouts of 300 guests.
trusted_s1: Panoramic view of Taipei skyline & 101 Tower
trusted_s3: Professional sound system & LED wall screens
trusted_s5: A venue with its own identity & atmosphere
events_intro: Let's craft your company event together. Contact us to share your needs and we'll provide a detailed quotation tailored to your vision.
events_note: Indicated prices are minimum spend — all food, beverages and services included.
pkg1_desc: Custom cocktail menu crafted by our team. Quotation required.
pkg2_desc: 300 NTD$ drink tickets per guest — flexible and easy to manage.
pkg3_desc: 400 NTD$ per guest per hour. Food budget recommended at 400 NTD$ per person.

ingredients_dictionary.Gin: Premium London Dry Gin distilled with botanical juniper berries.
ingredients_dictionary.Lime: Freshly squeezed green limes for clean citrus acidity.
ingredients_dictionary.Watermelon Syrup: House-pressed watermelon juice simmered fresh daily.
ingredients_dictionary.Watermelon Ice Cubes: Frozen fresh watermelon juice so the drink never dilutes.
ingredients_dictionary.Earl Grey Infused Gin: Gin cold-steeped with premium Earl Grey tea leaves.
ingredients_dictionary.Oolong Infused Whiskey: Bourbon whiskey cold-infused with high-mountain Alishan oolong tea for 72 hours.
ingredients_dictionary.Ginger: Freshly juiced local spicy ginger root.
ingredients_dictionary.Homemade Green Szechuan Peppercorn Lique: Infused Green Szechuan peppercorns drawing a numbing and aromatic citrus finish.
ingredients_dictionary.Passion Fruit: Freshly scooped local sweet-tart passion fruits.
ingredients_dictionary.Magao: Taiwanese wild mountain pepper with lemongrass and ginger aromas.
ingredients_dictionary.Calamansi: Local citrus hybrid resembling sweet lime and tangerine.
ingredients_dictionary.Cucumber & Kaffir Lime Leaf Syrup: House-pressed cucumber juice simmered with aromatic kaffir lime leaves.
ingredients_dictionary.Sour Plum Soup Infused Whiskey: Whiskey cold-infused with traditional slow-cooked sour plum tea (Suanmeitang).
ingredients_dictionary.Smoky Islay: Peated single malt Scotch whiskey from Islay, adding a campfire aroma.
ingredients_dictionary.VSOP Cognac: Double-distilled French grape brandy aged in oak barrels.
ingredients_dictionary.Homemade Chocolate Liqueur: Rich dark chocolate liqueur prepared in-house.
ingredients_dictionary.Sparkling Wine Reduction: Concentrated white sparkling wine reduction adding deep grape sweetness.
ingredients_dictionary.Yuzu Kosho: Japanese fermented paste made from fresh yuzu peel, green chili, and salt.
ingredients_dictionary.Durango Mezcal: Artisanal smoky agave spirit from Durango, Mexico.
ingredients_dictionary.Jalapeño: Fresh sliced spicy green jalapeño chili peppers.
ingredients_dictionary.Apple Eau de Vie: Clear fruit brandy distilled from fresh apples.
ingredients_dictionary.Acid Rectified Lillet: Lillet blanc fortified wine balanced with citric and malic acids.
ingredients_dictionary.Egg Whites: Fresh pasteurized egg whites adding a silky foam head.
ingredients_dictionary.Ginger Syrup: Fresh ginger juice simmered with organic sugar.
ingredients_dictionary.Amaras Verde Mezcal: Artisanal organic espadín mezcal from Oaxaca, notes of smoke and sweet herbs.
ingredients_dictionary.Calamansis White Pepper: A complex infusion of local calamansi citrus and crushed white peppercorns.
ingredients_dictionary.James E Pepper Rye: Premium straight rye whiskey with bold spicy notes and a hint of vanilla.
ingredients_dictionary.Peychaud Bitters: Aromatic, anise-flavored bitters created in New Orleans.
ingredients_dictionary.Merlet VSOP Cognac: Double-distilled premium French VSOP Cognac aged in oak.
ingredients_dictionary.Merlet Cognac VSOP: Double-distilled premium French VSOP Cognac aged in oak.
ingredients_dictionary.Benedictine: A historic herbal liqueur from Normandy, infused with 27 plants and spices.
ingredients_dictionary.Cointreau: Premium French orange liqueur made with sweet and bitter orange peels.
ingredients_dictionary.Maison Fontaine Absinthe Blanche: Ultra-premium white absinthe distilled in Pontarlier, France.
ingredients_dictionary.Champagne: Crisp and elegant French sparkling wine.
